curriculum.lesson_evidence: Planning a class commemoration means choosing its purpose, deciding who will take part, setting the order of the program, giving roles and thinking about respectful behaviour. A good plan is safe, simple and considers everyone in the class.

lesson.child_mission: Planning a class commemoration means choosing its purpose, deciding who will take part, setting the order of the program, giving roles and thinking about respectful behaviour. A good plan is safe, simple and considers everyone in the class.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Put in order: minute's silence; welcome; thank you; reading.

FEEDBACK
Welcome; reading; minute's silence; thank you.

WATCH FOR
Planning a long program with no roles or quiet moments makes the event hard to follow and less respectful.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Plan a class commemoration for a day of significance. Write the purpose, a timed program with five parts, roles for four students and three rules for respectful behaviour. Include a short script for the speaker.

Write a short reflection naming one source or idea you corrected and why.
